title: ETs teleport into CE-5 circle

tellings.quote: And we have had experiences where the ETs themselves have teleported right into our circle

plain: Steven Greer, a former doctor who leads groups trying to contact extraterrestrials, runs what he calls CE-5 sessions, short for "close encounter of the fifth kind": people sitting in a circle and meditating to invite contact. Greer says that in some of these sessions the ETs themselves have teleported right into the circle. If true, it would mean humans can bring about contact on purpose.
